result.topic_en: Case 2 of a construction in the theory of biquadratic residues, where y and Y are integers: Gaussian integers θ = T+Vi are formed from the fractional parts of x and X, signs ε are tabulated, and properties of the resulting set Θ are stated (distinctness, bounds, completeness).

methods.what: Fractional parts relative to nearest integers, scaled by b
Definition of Gaussian integer t+ui as a linear combination of x^0, X^0
Sign rule for ε depending on signs of b, x^0, X^0 and parity of t+u
Assignment of θ, θ' (or θ'') according to signs of x^0 and X^0
Numerical table of y, Y, x^0, X^0, t+ui, θ, θ', ε

items.quote:
1) Dass alle $\theta$, die aus (1) und aus (2) hervorgegangen sind, unter
einander verschieden sind. Ihr Complexus heisse $\Theta$
items.english: 1) That all θ arising from (1) and from (2) are distinct from one another. Let their totality be called Θ.

items.quote:
2) Dass alle $\theta = T + Vi$ die Eigenschaft haben, dass
$-bT + aU$
$-BT + AU$
[-ganze-] positive Zahlen kleiner als $\frac{1}{2}b$ sind
items.english: 2) That all θ = T + Vi have the property that −bT + aU and −BT + AU are positive numbers less than b/2.

items.quote:
3) Dass wenn [-für T, di-] T, V zwei der eben genannten Bedingungen unter-
worfene ganze Zahlen sind, $T + Vi$ sich gewiss in $\Theta$ findet.
items.english: 3) That if T, V are two integers subject to the conditions just named, T + Vi certainly occurs in Θ.
